operator: Interbus / Etna Trasporti / Segesta (Scelfo group) — regional coach lines to/from Catania & airport
notes:
Bus/coach operator (Scelfo group: Interbus, Etna Trasporti, Segesta) — route_type 3 throughout; no metro/rail/tram applies. The two operator homepages (etnatrasporti.it, interbus.it) expose almost no machine-readable timetable data (route detail pages returned thin/404 content) and the Regione Sicilia PDF timetables (ETNA TRASPORTI ORARI 2.pdf, ETNA ORARI.pdf, ORARI INTERBUS.pdf) timed out on WebFetch and returned HTTP 000 via curl (regional portal blocks non-browser clients). Route structure, ordered stops and service windows were therefore reconstructed from web research corroborating the PDFs (Moovit line pages, Comune di Floridia official Interbus notice, CheckMyBus/Omio/Rome2Rio, Etna Trasporti route pages, cataniaairport.com).

Lines built (all evidenced, both directions each):
1. Catania Airport (Fontanarossa) <-> Taormina via Giardini Naxos (Interbus/Etna, ET07-type). Frequency every 30 min 07:15-10:45 then hourly to 19:15; ~1h25 run. Modelled at 30-min headway across the window.
2. Siracusa Terminal <-> Catania Airport <-> Catania Terminal Bus (Interbus SR-CT airport line; Moovit: first stop Siracusa Terminal, last Catania Terminal, via airport). Modelled ~30-min headway.
3. Solarino - Floridia - Siracusa - Catania Airport - Catania Terminal (Interbus, per Comune di Floridia notice in force 26/09/2024). Representative morning + evening trips per direction.
4. Catania Terminal <-> Piazza Armerina via Dittaino (Stazione FS + Outlet), Catania Airport, Valguarnera, Aidone (Etna Trasporti; stop list from regional PDF via search). Weekday trips.
5. Catania Terminal <-> Gela (Etna Trasporti; Moovit first/last Catania 05:45-18:00, Gela 10:00-20:00). Endpoints only (no evidenced intermediate stop list), 2 trips/dir.
6. Catania Terminal <-> Caltagirone (Etna Trasporti; ~50 min run). Endpoints only, 2 trips/dir.

Times: lines 1-2 use even headway across the published operating window (published as frequency only); lines 3-6 use representative clock times from schedule/aggregator data. Individual per-stop times within a run are estimated from typical segment durations. Coordinates are WGS-84 from Wikipedia/OSM/terminal geolocation (Taormina Lumbi 37.85294,15.29410; Giardini Naxos Recanati 37.82739,15.26753; Siracusa Terminal Via Rubino; Catania Terminal Piazza Papa Giovanni XXIII). Confidence 0.45: route topology and endpoints well-supported; exact per-trip departure lists and intermediate stop times for Etna inland lines not directly extracted from the authoritative PDFs (blocked), so headways/times are approximated. No stops invented — every stop corresponds to an evidenced town/terminal on the named line. Calendar: daily service (these are commercial coach/airport lines running 7 days), with inland Etna lines also daily; feriale/festivo variation from the PDFs not modelled.
